name: nixhm-sudo-oci-mail
description: Home Manager system image for oci-mail (Stalwart, SnappyMail, Maddy, Dagu)

disk._comment: HM activation peak revised 2026-05-05: full peak (~10GB) only on first-ever pull; subsequent ships hit cache (image already in /var/lib/docker overlay2 from prior pulls) and peak is ~6-7GB (cp -aR /nix/store + nix-build /tmp). VM only has 47GB and runs full mail stack (~33GB committed after pre-flight engine prunes vm-system.tar.gz orphans + apt-cache + image pruning).

public_ports.desc: SMTP (Maddy MX — must be public, RFC)
SMTP proxy (CF Worker ingress — Cloudflare has no WireGuard)
